exposure: presence of extrauterine disease in placenta percreta
absence of extrauterine disease in placenta percreta
outcome: need for additional measures to control pelvic bleeding
cohort: 73 women who underwent primary cesarean hysterectomy with intrapartum confirmation of placenta previa percreta (FIGO grade 3 or higher) at a large tertiary referral center.
finding: Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) with extrauterine disease is associated with significantly higher maternal morbidity, including increased blood loss, transfusion requirements, bladder injuries, longer operating times, and ICU admissions, compared to PAS confined to the uterus.
